title: WO.EXP.PR.------DYM.SPT.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 135 (ALT(FT)II-29). WO-EXP-PR is the subject; DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism) is the partner. From the subject: CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis), PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) and AF-POST (affinity postulation). From CULT-AF-B: EXB-H-OR (establishing high order). From PROJ-DY: INFO-DE-B (information degrees). From AF-POST: RE-CONT (recontinuance). From EXB-H-OR: TR-INFO (trans-information). From INFO-DE-B: APL-DT (application dictates). From RE-CONT: PRI-INFO (principle information).
